Calculated as (Damage × (Whirlwind Hit - 1) + Whirlwind Damage) ÷ (Swingrate × Whirlwind Hit) from Level 2+.

For Level 4, DPS is calculated as (Threshold + Knife Damage × Knife Count) ÷ (Threshold ÷ ((Damage × (Whirlwind Hit - 1) + Whirlwind Damage) ÷ Whirlwind Hit) × Swingrate + Knife Cooldown) assuming all knives hit one enemy.
